sections.text: مقدمة

This document
 outlines the maintenance procedures P1 of main steam stop valve, depend 
 on external or internal leakage.

This valve is used for feed the water to the drum and de-superheat the main 
 steam.

Check any external leakage.

sections.text:
Disassembly 
 the valve
Attach a sling to the actuator (1) assembly.
Remove the stem clamp (2)
Remove the packing flange (3) and yoke clamp (4).
Lift the actuator assembly from the body (5) assembly and rem
Screw off nut (6) of bolt (7) which connected bonnet (8) with valve body.
Remove the bonnet from the body.
Remove the bonnet gasket (9) and upper spaces gasket (10).

Remove the packing (11) as follows:
 - قم بإزالة شفة التعبئة وتابع التعبئة (12)
 - Using a packing tool, remove all packing.
 - استبدال حجم التعبئة المناسب على جزء من العمود بنفس القطر 
 من صمام المغزل (13).
Remove the spindle.
Lift the disk stack (14) assembly from the body.
Remove the seat ring (15) from the body.
Remove the flex. gaskets (16) from the seat ring.

sections.text:
Inspect and Repair of all 
 parts

Check the body from any cracks or wear by using penetration 
 fluids and repair it if needed.
Check the seat ring and regrind it if needed.
Check the spindle and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the flex. gaskets and change it if needed.
Check the bushing (17) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the packing and change it if needed.

تحقق من تابع التعبئة، وفاصل التعبئة، وشفة التعبئة، و 
 إصلاحه إذا لزم الأمر أو استبداله.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of disassembly
افتح الصمام وأغلقه وتأكد من تشغيل الصمام بشكل صحيح.

rows:
Inspect the steam and replace the assembly if it is 
 damaged, also replace the packing

- Disassemble the valve, check for damage to the seat 
 ring/spindle and seals and replace as necessary
- Seat grinding
